# Startefacts

> > Startefacts is a film and entertainment publication covering classic cinema, award history, and Hollywood analysis with a focus on Western films and Academy Awards.

The site explores overlooked achievements in film history, particularly examining Oscar snubs and underappreciated classics. Coverage includes detailed analyses of Western cinema, award ceremonies, and the legacies of filmmakers like Clint Eastwood.

## Key Topics

- Classic Westerns
- Academy Awards & Oscar Snubs
- Clint Eastwood
- Unforgiven
- Dances With Wolves
- Cimarron
- Award-Overlooked Films
- Movie History
- Dolby Theatre
- Louise Everitt
- Lady Gaga
- Classic Films Analysis
- Hollywood Award History

## Western Films & Oscar History

- [10 Classic Westerns That Deserved Oscars, But Got Snubbed Instead](https://startefacts.com/news/10-classic-westerns-that-deserved-oscars-but-got-snubbed-instead_a117): Lists classic westerns like Unforgiven that were overlooked by Academy Awards
